name: culturepulse
description: Map-first app for Gen Z micro-scenes and pop-up events — discover, host, and attend authentic youth-led gatherings.

scripts.dev: npm run seed --workspace=@culturepulse/api && concurrently -n api,jobs,app,admin -c lime,magenta,cyan,yellow "npm run dev -w @culturepulse/api" "npm run dev -w @culturepulse/jobs" "npm run dev -w @culturepulse/app" "npm run dev -w @culturepulse/admin"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @culturepulse/api && npm run build -w @culturepulse/app && npm run build -w @culturepulse/admin && npm run build -w @culturepulse/jobs

author: abstractednick
